WITH observed_request_rows AS (
         SELECT analysis_requests.id AS request_id,
            analysis_requests.created_at
           FROM public.analysis_requests

         SELECT analysis_provider_usage_expectations.request_id,
            analysis_provider_usage_expectations.created_at
           FROM public.analysis_provider_usage_expectations
        UNION ALL
         SELECT analysis_gemini_usage_expectations.request_id,
            analysis_gemini_usage_expectations.created_at
           FROM public.analysis_gemini_usage_expectations
        UNION ALL
         SELECT analysis_provider_cost_ledger.request_id,
            analysis_provider_cost_ledger.created_at
           FROM public.analysis_provider_cost_ledger
          WHERE (analysis_provider_cost_ledger.request_id IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT gemini_token_usage.request_id,
            gemini_token_usage.created_at
           FROM public.gemini_token_usage
          WHERE (gemini_token_usage.request_id IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT scraper_provider_usage.request_id,
            scraper_provider_usage.created_at
           FROM public.scraper_provider_usage
          WHERE (scraper_provider_usage.request_id IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT analysis_step_events.request_id,
            analysis_step_events.created_at
           FROM public.analysis_step_events
        ), observed_requests AS (
         SELECT observed_request_rows.request_id,
            min(observed_request_rows.created_at) AS first_observed_at
           FROM observed_request_rows
          GROUP BY observed_request_rows.request_id
        ), provider_cost AS (
         SELECT expectation.request_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS provider_expected_run_count,
            (count(ledger.run_id))::integer AS provider_run_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (ledger.status = 'running'::text)))::integer AS provider_running_run_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((ledger.run_id IS NULL) OR (ledger.status = 'running'::text) OR (ledger.usage_total_usd IS NULL))))::integer AS provider_missing_actual_run_count,
            COALESCE(sum(ledger.usage_total_usd), (0)::numeric) AS provider_actual_cost_usd,
            COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(ledger.usage_total_usd, ledger.max_charge_usd, expectation.max_charge_usd)), (0)::numeric) AS provider_conservative_cost_usd
           FROM (public.analysis_provider_usage_expectations expectation
             LEFT JOIN public.analysis_provider_cost_ledger ledger ON (((ledger.request_id = expectation.request_id) AND (ledger.operation_key = expectation.operation_key))))
          GROUP BY expectation.request_id
        ), gemini_cost AS (
         SELECT gemini_token_usage.request_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS gemini_record_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (gemini_token_usage.cached_hit IS TRUE)))::integer AS gemini_cache_hit_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (gemini_token_usage.estimated_cost_usd IS NULL)))::integer AS gemini_missing_estimate_count,
            COALESCE(sum(gemini_token_usage.prompt_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS gemini_prompt_tokens,
            COALESCE(sum(gemini_token_usage.total_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS gemini_total_tokens,
            COALESCE(sum(gemini_token_usage.estimated_cost_usd), (0)::numeric) AS gemini_estimated_cost_usd,
            (round(avg(gemini_token_usage.latency_ms) FILTER (WHERE (gemini_token_usage.latency_ms IS NOT NULL))))::integer AS gemini_average_latency_ms
           FROM public.gemini_token_usage
          WHERE (gemini_token_usage.request_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY gemini_token_usage.request_id
        ), gemini_expectation AS (
         SELECT analysis_gemini_usage_expectations.request_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS gemini_expected_operation_count,
            (sum(analysis_gemini_usage_expectations.expected_record_count))::integer AS gemini_expected_record_count
           FROM public.analysis_gemini_usage_expectations
          GROUP BY analysis_gemini_usage_expectations.request_id
        ), scraper_usage AS (
         SELECT scraper_provider_usage.request_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS scraper_call_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (scraper_provider_usage.status = 'error'::text)))::integer AS scraper_error_count,
            COALESCE(sum(scraper_provider_usage.result_count), (0)::bigint) AS scraper_result_count,
            COALESCE(sum(scraper_provider_usage.estimated_cost_usd), (0)::numeric) AS scraper_estimated_cost_usd,
            (round(avg(scraper_provider_usage.latency_ms)))::integer AS scraper_average_latency_ms
           FROM public.scraper_provider_usage
          WHERE (scraper_provider_usage.request_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY scraper_provider_usage.request_id
        ), step_history AS (
         SELECT analysis_step_events.request_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS step_event_count,
            min(analysis_step_events.created_at) FILTER (WHERE (analysis_step_events.event_type = 'started'::text)) AS first_step_started_at,
            max(analysis_step_events.created_at) AS last_step_event_at,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (analysis_step_events.event_type = 'retrying'::text)))::integer AS retry_event_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (analysis_step_events.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'aborted'::text]))))::integer AS failure_event_count
           FROM public.analysis_step_events
          GROUP BY analysis_step_events.request_id
        )
 SELECT observed_request.request_id,

    COALESCE(gemini_cost.gemini_estimated_cost_usd, (0)::numeric) AS gemini_estimated_cost_usd,

    COALESCE(scraper_usage.scraper_call_count, 0) AS scraper_call_count,

    COALESCE(step_history.retry_event_count, 0) AS retry_event_count,
    COALESCE(step_history.failure_event_count, 0) AS failure_event_count,
    COALESCE(provider_cost.provider_expected_run_count, 0) AS provider_expected_run_count,

    COALESCE(gemini_expectation.gemini_expected_record_count, 0) AS gemini_expected_record_count
   FROM ((((((observed_requests observed_request

     LEFT JOIN provider_cost ON ((provider_cost.request_id = observed_request.request_id)))

            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (source.joined_preflight_id IS NULL) THEN (0)::numeric
                    WHEN ((source.status = ANY (ARRAY['rejected'::text, 'resolved_no_run'::text])) AND (source.actual_usage_usd = (0)::numeric)) THEN (0)::numeric
                    WHEN (source.status = 'resolved_identity_drift'::text) THEN source.max_charge_usd

            COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceKind', 'preflight_provider_run', 'operationKey', source.source_operation_key, 'provider', source.logical_provider, 'actor', source.actor_id, 'credentialSlot', source.credential_slot, 'status', source.status, 'actualChargeUsd',
                CASE
                    WHEN ((source.status = ANY (ARRAY['succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text, 'aborted'::text, 'timed_out'::text])) AND (source.run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source.actual_usage_usd IS NOT NULL) AND (source.usage_reconciled_at IS NOT NULL)) THEN source.actual_usage_usd
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END, 'conservativeEstimateUsd',
                CASE
                    WHEN (source.status = 'resolved_identity_drift'::text) THEN source.max_charge_usd
                    WHEN ((source.status = ANY (ARRAY['starting'::text, 'running'::text])) OR (source.actual_usage_usd IS NULL) OR (source.usage_reconciled_at IS NULL)) THEN source.max_charge_usd
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END, 'noCall', ((source.status = ANY (ARRAY['rejected'::text, 'resolved_no_run'::text])) AND (source.actual_usage_usd = (0)::numeric) AND (source.usage_reconciled_at IS NOT NULL)), 'usageUnknown', ((source.joined_preflight_id IS NULL) OR (source.status = ANY (ARRAY['starting'::text, 'running'::text])) OR (source.status = 'resolved_identity_drift'::text) OR (source.actual_usage_usd IS NULL) OR (source.usage_reconciled_at IS NULL))) ORDER BY source.source_operation_key) FILTER (WHERE (source.joined_preflight_id IS NOT NULL)), '[]'::jsonb) AS provenance

        ), provider_rollup AS (

            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (((provider_run.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['succeeded'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'aborted'::character varying, 'timed_out'::character varying])::text[])) AND (provider_run.run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_run.manual_resolution_kind IS NULL) AND (provider_run.actual_usage_usd IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_run.usage_reconciled_at IS NOT NULL))))::integer AS actual_count,
            COALESCE(sum(provider_run.actual_usage_usd) FILTER (WHERE (((provider_run.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['succeeded'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'aborted'::character varying, 'timed_out'::character varying])::text[])) AND (provider_run.run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_run.manual_resolution_kind IS NULL) AND (provider_run.actual_usage_usd IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_run.usage_reconciled_at IS NOT NULL))), (0)::numeric) AS actual_usd,
            COALESCE(sum(provider_run.actual_usage_usd) FILTER (WHERE (((provider_run.logical_provider)::text = 'apify'::text) AND ((provider_run.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['succeeded'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'aborted'::character varying, 'timed_out'::character varying])::text[])) AND (provider_run.run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_run.manual_resolution_kind IS NULL) AND (provider_run.actual_usage_usd IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_run.usage_reconciled_at IS NOT NULL))), (0)::numeric) AS apify_actual_usd,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE

                    WHEN (provider_run.manual_resolution_kind = 'conservative_max_charge'::text) THEN provider_run.max_charge_usd
                    WHEN (((provider_run.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['starting'::character varying, 'running'::character varying])::text[])) OR (provider_run.actual_usage_usd IS NULL) OR (provider_run.usage_reconciled_at IS NULL)) THEN provider_run.max_charge_usd
                    ELSE provider_run.actual_usage_usd
                END), (0)::numeric) AS conservative_usd,
            COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceKind', 'analysis_provider_run', 'operationKey', provider_run.operation_key, 'provider', provider_run.logical_provider, 'actor', provider_run.actor_id, 'credentialSlot', provider_run.credential_slot, 'status', provider_run.status, 'actualChargeUsd',
                CASE
                    WHEN (((provider_run.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['succeeded'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'aborted'::character varying, 'timed_out'::character varying])::text[])) AND (provider_run.run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_run.manual_resolution_kind IS NULL) AND (provider_run.actual_usage_usd IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_run.usage_reconciled_at IS NOT NULL)) THEN provider_run.actual_usage_usd
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END, 'conservativeEstimateUsd',
                CASE
                    WHEN (provider_run.manual_resolution_kind = 'conservative_max_charge'::text) THEN provider_run.max_charge_usd
                    WHEN (((provider_run.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['starting'::character varying, 'running'::character varying])::text[])) OR (provider_run.actual_usage_usd IS NULL) OR (provider_run.usage_reconciled_at IS NULL)) THEN provider_run.max_charge_usd
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END, 'noCall', (((provider_run.status)::text = 'rejected'::text) AND (provider_run.actual_usage_usd = (0)::numeric) AND (provider_run.usage_reconciled_at IS NOT NULL)), 'usageUnknown', (((provider_run.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['starting'::character varying, 'running'::character varying])::text[])) OR (provider_run.manual_resolution_kind IS NOT NULL) OR (provider_run.actual_usage_usd IS NULL) OR (provider_run.usage_reconciled_at IS NULL)), 'manualResolutionKind', provider_run.manual_resolution_kind) ORDER BY provider_run.operation_key), '[]'::jsonb) AS provenance
           FROM public.analysis_v2_provider_runs provider_run
          GROUP BY provider_run.request_id
        ), ai_rollup AS (
         SELECT ai_attempt.request_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS attempt_count,

            COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('canonicalModelName', ai_attempt.canonical_model_name, 'modelName', ai_attempt.model_name, 'modelLocation', ai_attempt.location, 'pricingVersion', ai_attempt.pricing_version, 'attempt', ai_attempt.attempt, 'status', ai_attempt.status, 'usageUnknown', ((ai_attempt.usage_complete IS DISTINCT FROM true) OR (ai_attempt.metered_estimated_cost_usd IS NULL) OR (ai_attempt.cache_read_tokens IS NULL) OR (ai_attempt.canonical_model_name IS NULL) OR (ai_attempt.pricing_version IS NULL)), 'meteredEstimatedCostUsd', ai_attempt.metered_estimated_cost_usd) ORDER BY ai_attempt.operation_key, ai_attempt.attempt) FILTER (WHERE (ai_attempt.status <> 'reserved'::text)), '[]'::jsonb) AS provenance

        ), selfhosted_rollup AS (

            COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceKind', 'selfhosted_auth', 'operationKey', receipt.operation_key, 'provider', 'selfhosted_auth', 'status', 'succeeded', 'providerChargeUsd', (0)::numeric, 'chargeKind', 'no_paid_provider', 'usageUnknown', false) ORDER BY receipt.operation_key), '[]'::jsonb) AS provenance

        ), vertex_budget_rollup AS (

            (count(*))::integer AS reservation_count,

    GREATEST((COALESCE(preflight_source.source_count, 0) - COALESCE(preflight_source.joined_source_count, 0)), 0) AS preflight_attribution_gap_count,
    ((COALESCE(preflight_source.source_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(preflight_zero.no_paid_provider_count, 0) = 0)) AS preflight_coverage_unknown,
    (COALESCE(preflight_source.usage_unknown_count, 0) + COALESCE(preflight_zero.usage_unknown_count, 0)) AS preflight_usage_unknown_count,
    (COALESCE(preflight_source.no_call_count, 0) + COALESCE(preflight_zero.no_call_count, 0)) AS preflight_no_call_count,
    COALESCE(preflight_zero.no_paid_provider_count, 0) AS preflight_no_paid_provider_count,
    COALESCE(preflight_source.apify_actual_count, 0) AS preflight_apify_actual_count,
    COALESCE(preflight_source.actual_usd, (0)::numeric) AS preflight_provider_actual_usd,
    COALESCE(preflight_source.apify_actual_usd, (0)::numeric) AS preflight_apify_actual_charge_usd,
    COALESCE(preflight_source.conservative_usd, (0)::numeric) AS preflight_provider_conservative_usd,
    COALESCE(provider.run_count, 0) AS provider_run_count,
    COALESCE(provider.active_count, 0) AS provider_active_count,
    COALESCE(provider.usage_unknown_count, 0) AS provider_usage_unknown_count,
    COALESCE(provider.no_call_count, 0) AS provider_no_call_count,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(provider.run_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(selfhosted.no_paid_provider_count, 0) = 0)) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS provider_coverage_gap_count,
    COALESCE(provider.actual_count, 0) AS provider_actual_count,
    COALESCE(provider.apify_actual_count, 0) AS provider_apify_actual_count,
    COALESCE(provider.actual_usd, (0)::numeric) AS provider_actual_usd,
    COALESCE(provider.apify_actual_usd, (0)::numeric) AS apify_actual_charge_usd,
    COALESCE(provider.conservative_usd, (0)::numeric) AS provider_conservative_usd,
    COALESCE(ai.attempt_count, 0) AS ai_attempt_count,
    COALESCE(ai.reserved_count, 0) AS ai_reserved_count,
    COALESCE(ai.usage_unknown_count, 0) AS ai_usage_unknown_count,
    COALESCE(ai.metered_cost_count, 0) AS ai_metered_cost_count,
    COALESCE(ai.metered_estimated_usd, (0)::numeric) AS metered_estimated_cost_usd,
    COALESCE(ai.input_tokens, (0)::bigint) AS ai_input_tokens,
    COALESCE(ai.output_tokens, (0)::bigint) AS ai_output_tokens,
    COALESCE(ai.cache_tokens, (0)::bigint) AS ai_cache_tokens,
    COALESCE(cache.cache_hit_count, 0) AS cache_hit_count,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(ai.attempt_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(cache.cache_hit_count, 0) = 0)) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS ai_coverage_gap_count,
    COALESCE(selfhosted.no_paid_provider_count, 0) AS selfhosted_no_paid_provider_count,
    COALESCE(vertex_budget.reservation_count, 0) AS vertex_budget_reservation_count,
    COALESCE(vertex_budget.matched_count, 0) AS vertex_budget_matched_count,
    COALESCE(vertex_budget.unmatched_count, 0) AS vertex_budget_unmatched_count,
    COALESCE(vertex_budget.usage_unknown_count, 0) AS vertex_budget_usage_unknown_count,
    (COALESCE(vertex_budget.duplicate_count, (0)::bigint))::integer AS vertex_budget_duplicate_count,
    COALESCE(vertex_budget.mismatch_count, 0) AS vertex_budget_mismatch_count,
    COALESCE(vertex_budget.conservative_fallback_usd, (0)::numeric) AS vertex_budget_conservative_fallback_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN (((request.policy_versions_snapshot ->> 'aiStage'::text) = 'ai-stage-policy-v2.12'::text) AND (COALESCE(vertex_budget.reservation_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(cache.cache_hit_count, 0) = 0)) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS vertex_budget_coverage_gap_count,
    ((COALESCE(preflight_source.no_call_count, 0) + COALESCE(preflight_zero.no_call_count, 0)) + COALESCE(provider.no_call_count, 0)) AS provider_no_call_count_total,
    (((COALESCE(preflight_source.no_call_count, 0) + COALESCE(preflight_zero.no_call_count, 0)) + COALESCE(provider.no_call_count, 0)) + COALESCE(cache.cache_hit_count, 0)) AS no_call_count,
    (COALESCE(preflight_source.actual_usd, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(provider.actual_usd, (0)::numeric)) AS provider_actual_total_usd,
    (COALESCE(preflight_source.conservative_usd, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(provider.conservative_usd, (0)::numeric)) AS provider_conservative_total_usd,
    ((COALESCE(preflight_source.actual_usd, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(provider.actual_usd, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(ai.metered_estimated_usd, (0)::numeric)) AS total_known_cost_usd,
    (((COALESCE(preflight_source.conservative_usd, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(provider.conservative_usd, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(ai.metered_estimated_usd, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(vertex_budget.conservative_fallback_usd, (0)::numeric)) AS total_conservative_cost_usd,
    ((((COALESCE(preflight_source.provenance, '[]'::jsonb) || COALESCE(preflight_zero.provenance, '[]'::jsonb)) || COALESCE(provider.provenance, '[]'::jsonb)) || COALESCE(ai.provenance, '[]'::jsonb)) || COALESCE(selfhosted.provenance, '[]'::jsonb)) AS cost_provenance,
    (((request.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('completed'::character varying)::text, ('failed'::character varying)::text])) AND (COALESCE(preflight_source.source_count, 0) = COALESCE(preflight_source.joined_source_count, 0)) AND ((COALESCE(preflight_source.source_count, 0) > 0) OR (COALESCE(preflight_zero.no_paid_provider_count, 0) > 0)) AND (GREATEST((COALESCE(preflight_source.source_count, 0) - COALESCE(preflight_source.joined_source_count, 0)), 0) = 0) AND ((COALESCE(preflight_source.usage_unknown_count, 0) + COALESCE(preflight_zero.usage_unknown_count, 0)) = 0) AND (COALESCE(provider.active_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(provider.usage_unknown_count, 0) = 0) AND ((COALESCE(provider.run_count, 0) > 0) OR (COALESCE(selfhosted.no_paid_provider_count, 0) > 0)) AND (COALESCE(ai.reserved_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(ai.usage_unknown_count, 0) = 0) AND ((COALESCE(ai.attempt_count, 0) > 0) OR (COALESCE(cache.cache_hit_count, 0) > 0)) AND (((request.policy_versions_snapshot ->> 'aiStage'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'ai-stage-policy-v2.12'::text) OR (((COALESCE(vertex_budget.reservation_count, 0) > 0) AND (COALESCE(vertex_budget.unmatched_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(vertex_budget.usage_unknown_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(vertex_budget.duplicate_count, (0)::bigint) = 0) AND (COALESCE(vertex_budget.mismatch_count, 0) = 0)) OR ((COALESCE(vertex_budget.reservation_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(cache.cache_hit_count, 0) > 0))))) AS directly_attributable_cost_complete,
    ((((((((((GREATEST((COALESCE(preflight_source.source_count, 0) - COALESCE(preflight_source.joined_source_count, 0)), 0) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(preflight_source.source_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(preflight_zero.no_paid_provider_count, 0) = 0)) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) + COALESCE(preflight_source.usage_unknown_count, 0)) + COALESCE(preflight_zero.usage_unknown_count, 0)) + COALESCE(provider.usage_unknown_count, 0)) + COALESCE(ai.usage_unknown_count, 0)) + COALESCE(ai.reserved_count, 0)) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(provider.run_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(selfhosted.no_paid_provider_count, 0) = 0)) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(ai.attempt_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(cache.cache_hit_count, 0) = 0)) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        CASE
            WHEN (NOT ((request.policy_versions_snapshot ->> 'aiStage'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'ai-stage-policy-v2.12'::text)) THEN ((((COALESCE(vertex_budget.unmatched_count, 0) + COALESCE(vertex_budget.usage_unknown_count, 0)) + COALESCE(vertex_budget.duplicate_count, (0)::bigint)) + COALESCE(vertex_budget.mismatch_count, 0)) +
            CASE
                WHEN ((COALESCE(vertex_budget.reservation_count, 0) = 0) AND (COALESCE(cache.cache_hit_count, 0) = 0)) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END)
            ELSE (0)::bigint
        END) > 0) AS usage_unknown
   FROM ((((((((public.analysis_requests request
     LEFT JOIN preflight_rollup preflight_source ON ((preflight_source.request_id = request.id)))
     LEFT JOIN preflight_zero_sources preflight_zero ON ((preflight_zero.request_id = request.id)))
     LEFT JOIN provider_rollup provider ON ((provider.request_id = request.id)))
     LEFT JOIN ai_rollup ai ON ((ai.request_id = request.id)))
     LEFT JOIN cache_rollup cache ON ((cache.request_id = request.id)))
     LEFT JOIN selfhosted_rollup selfhosted ON ((selfhosted.request_id = request.id)))
     LEFT JOIN vertex_budget_rollup vertex_budget ON ((vertex_budget.request_id_text = (request.id)::text)))
     LEFT JOIN order_rollup order_source ON ((order_source.request_id = request.id)))
  WHERE ((request.pipeline_version = 'v2'::text) AND (request.plan_access_mode_snapshot = ANY (ARRAY['production'::text, 'test_entitlement'::text])) AND (request.selected_plan_id_snapshot = ANY (ARRAY['basic'::text, 'standard'::text, 'plus'::text])));
